item.title: Burke County, Lake Lure receive millions in FEMA funds to aid Helene recovery
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. (QUEEN CITY NEWS) — Three western North Carolina communities will receive more than $16.5 million in funding from the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) to continue recovery efforts following Hurricane Helene.
